app.name: GeoGuard
app.tagline: Weekly satellite watch over lakes and government land

demo.explain: Fictional places, people and records. Nothing here is a finding.

login.title: Sign in with a demo account
login.intro: Each account is fictional. The admin runs the application; officials see everything and record reviews.

role.admin: Runs the application: sources, documents and decisions on incidents
role.viewer: Sees every location, week and incident, and records reviews

login.citizen: Are you a citizen? Report a problem on public land

action.first_signature: You sign first. A second person must agree before it closes.
action.second_signature: A first signature is waiting. Your signature closes it.
action.waiting: Waiting for a second person to sign
action.awaiting: Signed. Waiting for a second person.
action.wait_review: Waiting for an official's review. You can also start the review yourself.

form.image_pair_reviewed: I compared the before and after images
form.gap_reason: Why the case file can go with gaps

class.RESTRICTED_PRIVATE: Private title claim in restricted zone

queue.title: Incidents
queue.empty_real: No change on a real location yet. The Locations page shows each one week by week.

detail.bracket_note: The change happened between the last clear image and the first changed image.
detail.permit_conflict: A permit overlaps the boundary or buffer. A permit here does not close the alert.
detail.imagery_done: Request recorded. Nothing is ordered in the prototype.

checklist.boundary_confirmed: Boundary confirmed by final notification or certified survey
checklist.survey_notice_given: Survey carried out with prior notice
checklist.no_live_court_matter: No live court matter or undertaking
checklist.title_permits_reviewed: Title claims and local permissions reviewed
checklist.construction_dated: Dated bracket shown against the policy cut-off

assets.title: Locations
assets.real_note: The real lakes use OpenStreetMap outlines, and outlines drawn by the admin are estimates too: for watching only, never for field action. Every watched location is screened from Sentinel-2 satellite images each week.
assets.no_links: Not linked to any government source yet.
assets.core_area: Lake bed (tank and shikam survey numbers inside the boundary): {{area}} sq m
assets.no_parcels: No land records loaded for this area yet.

records.title: Records
records.held: {{n}} open incidents now have a court case

audit.title: Audit
audit.ok: The log is intact: {{n}} entries checked.
audit.broken: The log has been altered at entry {{id}}: {{problem}}

statement.imagery: Imagery shows physical change. It does not establish title or legality.

error.forbidden: Your role cannot open this page.
error.not_found: This page could not be found.
error.image_failed: This image could not be loaded.

field.offline: No signal: saving on this phone
field.instruction: Go to the marked place. Photograph the change from the edge. Record what you see.
field.counsel_note: This is an observation, not a survey. Do not enter private land.
field.gps_unavailable: Position not available. Check that location is on.
field.distance_warn: You are {{m}} m from the change. Check that you are at the right place. You can still save.
field.need_photo: Add at least one photo and your position.
field.saved_offline: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when there is signal.

pack.title: Evidence pack
pack.draft: Certificate is a draft for counsel review
pack.needs_field: A pack can be made once the change is confirmed on site.

checklist_ui.gaps: Checklist gaps: {{items}}. Sending to the officer needs a logged reason.

monthly.title: Monthly page: {{month}}
monthly.map_legend: Blue: lakes and water bodies. Beige: government land. Amber dot: new incident this month. Red ring: waiting over {{days}} days for a decision.
monthly.list: Waiting over {{days}} days for a decision
monthly.source: Every figure comes from the system's records with no hand edits.

officer.title: Officer record
officer.note: The system suggests no outcome. The officer decides.
officer.recorded: Action recorded. The land stays on weekly watch.

screen.title: Screen from space, as of {{date}}
screen.unseen: {{count}} not seen clearly, so no finding for them
screen.never_run: No screen from space has run yet.

flag.seasonal_history_partial: No clear look in the same months of earlier years
flag.radar_confirmed: Radar confirms new built-up (3 dB or more)
flag.radar_unavailable: No radar look to confirm built-up
flag.citizen_report: Opened by a citizen's report: the outline is the reported spot, not a measured change
flag.satellite_change_seen: The satellite review saw a change at the reported spot
flag.placed_from_description: Placed from the citizen's words, not a pin: check the place

sources.title: Government sources
sources.lede: Where the boundary register comes from. Every source is read the same way: kept, checked, matched and versioned.
sources.no_agreement: No data-sharing agreement exists yet, so no government system is called. Sources load from files: an officer's drop folder, or fictional samples that load into the demo world.
sources.contract: Data contract: the files this source must send
sources.preview_note: Nothing has been written. This is exactly what loading would do.
sources.loaded_note: Written to the register. Boundaries are added as new versions; nothing was overwritten.
sources.sample_note: Sample data is fictional and belongs to the demo world.

review.title: Reviews by officials
review.already: You have reviewed this already. Another review adds to it.

incident.summary: {{change}} of about {{area}} sq m {{zone}}, first seen {{date}}
incident.court: A live court case covers this land. The legal team should see this first.
incident.boundary_unconfirmed: The boundary is not confirmed. Weigh this before any action.
incident.related: Seen again after an earlier incident was closed:

auto.CLOSED_LEGACY: Closed by the legal check: first seen on or before the baseline date. Recorded, not an incident.
auto.CLOSED_AUTHORISED: Closed by the legal check: it matches authorised works or a permit.
auto.CLOSED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Closed by the legal check: outside the boundary, buffer and watch ring.

weeks.title: Week by week
weeks.lede: Every weekly screen of this asset: whether it was seen clearly, that week's image, and what changed.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.lede: Week {{week}}. Every underlined number opens the incidents behind it.
dashboard.area_source: Districts and mandals of the OpenStreetMap lakes come from OpenStreetMap boundaries, not the revenue record.
dashboard.ack_none: No notifications to officials in the last 30 days

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.banner: You were notified about this incident on {{date}}.
inbox.banner_admin: Your next step on it acknowledges it.

officials.title: Officials
officials.lede: Who covers which area, and how each is told. An incident notifies the officials whose area holds it, and the admin.
officials.held: Not set up: messages are held
officials.admin_all: The admin is told about every incident.
officials.no_areas: No area: this official gets no notifications.
officials.digest_already: Digest for {{week}}: already sent to everyone.

locations.needs: Still needed before it can be watched
locations.add_lede: It joins the weekly screen from the next run. Locations are added to the real data, inside Telangana.
locations.name: Name (English)
locations.baseline_help: Changes first seen on or before this date are recorded as older changes and never open an incident.
locations.draw_help: Click the map to place each corner, then Finish. The satellite base map covers Hyderabad; for elsewhere, upload a file.
locations.upload_help: A GeoJSON or KML file with the outline as a polygon, in longitude and latitude (WGS 84).
locations.file_bad: No outline could be read from this file: {{why}}
locations.status_drawn: Estimated. An outline drawn on the screen is for watching only: its changes go to the watch list and never lead to field action.
locations.notification_ref: Reference of the notification, order or survey
locations.added: {{name}} is added. The next weekly screen includes it.
locations.stop_warn: The weekly screen leaves it out from the next run. Nothing is deleted: its boundaries, weeks, incidents and documents stay. Open incidents still need a decision: {{n}}.
locations.resume_warn: The weekly screen includes it again from the next run.
locations.from_reports: Made from citizens' reports; not watched

citizen.tagline: Weekly satellite watch over Telangana's lakes and government land
citizen.title: Report a problem on public land
citizen.lede: Seen soil dumped in a lake, a wall going up on government land, or trees cleared? Tell us. Officials check every report against satellite images and records.
citizen.place_help: Tap the map to drop a pin on the place, or use your location.
citizen.map_note: The satellite map covers Hyderabad. Elsewhere in Telangana, use your location.
citizen.location_failed: Your location could not be found. Tap the map instead.
citizen.photo_note: Location and camera details are removed from photos before they are kept.
citizen.describe_help: What you saw and when. Please do not name any person.
citizen.updates_help: Give your mobile number to get an SMS at each step. Without it, check with your reference number on this site.
citizen.updates_unavailable: Updates by SMS start once the State's SMS gateway is set up. For now, keep your reference number and check here.
citizen.name: Your name (optional)
citizen.demo_code: Demo: the code would arrive by SMS. It is {{code}}.
citizen.verified: Number verified. Updates will go to {{to}}.
citizen.consent: I agree that my number is used only to send updates on this report, and deleted 90 days after it closes.
citizen.need_place: Mark the place on the map first.
citizen.need_consent: To get updates, verify your number and agree to its use, or leave the number out.
citizen.thanks: Thank you. Your report is in.
citizen.keep_ref: Write it down or take a screenshot. Use it on this site to see what happened.
citizen.track_help: Enter the reference number you were given, like GGR-7K3M-9QXA.
citizen.privacy: We keep the place, what you saw and your photos. Your name and number are optional, used only for updates, and deleted 90 days after the report closes. Officials see your report, never your number. Nobody accused is ever shown in public.
citizen.not_finding: A report helps officials look. It is not a finding that anyone broke the law.
citizen.other_ways: You can also call the 1070 helpline, or tell Praja Vani. Staff enter those reports here too.
citizen.whatsapp_soon: WhatsApp reporting starts once the State's WhatsApp channel is set up.
citizen.stats: Last 30 days: {{received}} reports, {{checking}} being checked, {{closed}} closed.
citizen.demo_note: Demo: a fictional place. Nothing sent here is real.
citizen.demo_phone: In the demo, use a fictional number such as 0000000001.
citizen.failed: The report could not be sent: {{why}}

reports.title: Citizen reports
reports.lede: From the portal, WhatsApp, the 1070 helpline and Praja Vani. A report never makes a finding on its own: check it against the images and records.
reports.no_place: No pin: place it from the description
reports.duplicate_of: Same place as {{ref}}: it follows that report
reports.duplicates: {{n}} more reports of this place follow it
reports.updates_yes: Updates go to a verified phone ({{to}}). Officials never see the number.
reports.updates_no: No updates by phone: the citizen checks with the reference.
reports.repeat_false: Earlier reports from this source were closed as false.
reports.no_messages: None: the citizen did not ask for updates by phone.
reports.check_visible: A change is visible on the images
reports.reason_label: Reason (the citizen is told it, in their language)

reason.authorised: Covered by a recorded work or permission
reason.not_enough: Could not place or understand it

reports.false_report: Mark as a false report (counts towards flagging this source)
reports.add_location: Not watched? Add it on the Locations page, then place the report on it.
reports.intake_title: Enter a report taken by phone or in person
reports.intake_lede: For the 1070 helpline, Praja Vani petitions and visitors. Read the reference back to the caller.
reports.intake_place: Click the map where it is, or write the place below.
reports.intake_description: What the caller said (no names of persons)
reports.intake_phone: Caller's mobile (only if they want SMS updates)
reports.intake_wants: The caller wants updates by SMS, and agreed
reports.intake_done: Entered as {{ref}}. Read this reference back to the caller.
reports.sim_lede: The same conversation a citizen has on WhatsApp, from the fictional number {{number}}. Real messages arrive once the State's WhatsApp channel is set up.
reports.place_help: Click where it is. An incident opens there with a satellite review, as for any report.
reports.incident_flow: Officials work this report on its incident: reviews, sharper images, decision and closing.

citizen_incident.title: Reported by a citizen

placed.description: Placed from the citizen's words, not a pin: check the place
placed.official: Placed on the map by an official

citizen_incident.reported_place: Outside every watched location: a reported place, not on the weekly watch
citizen_incident.updates_yes: The citizen gets updates on a verified phone. Officials never see the number.
citizen_incident.updates_no: The citizen checks with the reference.
citizen_incident.review_title: Satellite review of the reported place

review.failed: The satellite review could not be done

citizen_incident.review_change: {{change}} of about {{area}} sq m, first seen {{date}}

source.sentinel-2: Sentinel-2, 10 m pixels: works smaller than about 1,000 sq m may not show

citizen_incident.pending_help: The screener looks at the newest Sentinel-2 images within minutes when it is running (docker compose --profile screen up -d reviewer).
citizen_incident.next: Next: review it, ask for a sharper image if the change is small, then decide with a note. The citizen is told each step.
citizen_incident.department: Passed to a department? (the citizen is told)
citizen_incident.no_department: No: not a change that needs action
citizen_incident.told: The citizens who reported it are told the outcome in their language. Your note stays inside.
